verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a bulk-operation capability, such as selecting and acting on many dashboards, alerts or resources at once. File-based provisioning and observability-as-code let users define dashboards and data sources in version-controlled files. That is a related configuration-as-code feature, not a documented bulk action across many items, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
